description:
RESTATED 2026-09-03 after a scoping pass at dd07432db. BOTH ORIGINAL GAPS ARE
WITHDRAWN ON MEASUREMENT, and the measurement found a real defect in their
place.

GAP (1), threading a PlanSite into surface_membership::observe, IS WITHDRAWN:
there is no live escape to attribute. FZ_STRESS_ASSERT_SURFACE_MEMBERSHIP=1
over 605 fixtures x 11 settings (settled, arms:reverse, arms:1..6,
wrappers:reverse, wrappers:1, wrappers:6) = 6,655 runs reports ZERO escapes at
every setting. fz-kdt.179 cured the population. The instrument itself is not
vacuous -- injecting a failure (deleting the admits(PositionScope::Full) half
of `escaped`) makes the settled corpus report 1,135 observations across 67
fixtures -- so the zero is a cure, not a blind spot. And the label is already
half-free without any threading: with FZ_STRESS_ASSERT_SURFACE_MEMBERSHIP=
abort and RUST_BACKTRACE=1, the five call sites are distinct debug frames
(backend.rs:606 entry clause, :835 call edge, :1068 local/tail, :1180 receive,
:2152 construction member), so the backtrace already names the plan KIND. What
it lacks is WHICH wrapper -- and there is nothing to attribute.

GAP (2), reading the unreadable question variants, IS WITHDRAWN: it buys the
denominator and no finding. Re-measured at head, the ticket`s old numbers
(335 of 406, List 498, Equal 137, Guard 83, TupleArity 72) are pre-178 and
describe nothing in the tree. Actual: 244 plans walked (call-edge 21, case 3,
entry 169, receive 2, selection 49) with 165 unreadable (67.6%), entry 169 of
which 162 unreadable. A prototype extension that reads List / TupleArity /
Equal / MapKind / Bitstring for SEPARATION (keeping Region::Type as the only
SURFACE, skipping only on Guard) was measured at four arrivals, identical
every time: plans read 79 -> 210, entry read 7 -> 135, unread 165 -> 34, arm
pairs examined 87 -> 218, Separated 36 -> 167, and BLIND-ESCAPE FINDINGS 0 ->
0. The reason is structural: Region::List(ListRegion) is Empty | Cons and
Region::TupleArity(u32) is an arity -- NEITHER CARRIES A TYPE -- and
EdgeEvidence carries only more RegionPredicates. The census`s relation is
surface x emitted test; at a shape-tested subject the plan holds no surface.
The extension can only move a plan-level skip to a pair-level skip.

THE REAL DEFECT, FOUND BY THAT MEASUREMENT: a tripwire census row that
OBSERVES NOTHING reads zero and passes, so its 0 means "nothing was looked at"
rather than "no escapes". SEVEN of the fifteen SURFACE_MEMBERSHIP_CENSUS rows
are vacuous today -- 00277_enum_tier0_fixture at settled, arms:6, wrappers:1,
wrappers:6 and wrappers:reverse, and enum_predicate_search at settled and
arms:6 -- all report ZERO observations under the injection above, while
dispatch_list_head_separates reads 4, 00183/00230/00419 read 36 each,
00418/unused_range_binding 6 each and 00420/enum_take_drop_split 375 each.
Cause, read off --dump backend=: 00277 now publishes five wrappers w0-w4, EACH
SINGLE-MEMBER WITH NO SELECTION PLAN, so select_construction_member takes the
`None if members.len() == 1` branch and no dispatch runs at all. The rows whose
doc says they hold fz-kdt.179`s cure are watching an empty room.

THE CHANGE: add an OBSERVATIONS counter beside ESCAPES (increment in `observe`
before the `escaped` call, exposed on SurfaceMembershipCensus); make
SURFACE_MEMBERSHIP_CENSUS a 4-tuple (fixture, setting, observations, escapes);
have the gate assert observations > 0 per row as well as escapes == expected.
Then re-home or delete the seven blind rows WITH THE REASON RECORDED --
fixtures that still exercise a member selection are enum_take_drop_split,
00420, 00183, 00230 and 00419; 179`s cure is simply unobservable on 00277 now
that fz-kdt.199 collapsed its wrappers to single members.

RED-FIRST: the seven rows report 0 observations and the gate fails at head;
green after re-homing. Cost: the gate is ~20 s and does not grow.

comments.text: BOTH GAPS ARE NOW PINNED NUMBERS (fz-kdt.178, 8de517a28). (1) SOURCE_ORDER_PLANS_ON_THE_CENSUS pins (kind, plans, unreadable): entry 144 / 137, case 3 / 3, receive 2 / 0 (the refuter found the case and receive plan kinds the first cut missed); the unreadable variants are Region::List, TupleArity, Guard, Equal, printed by the census gate; SOURCE_ORDER_BLIND_ESCAPES reads 0 over the readable ones. Reading Region::List and TupleArity (shape tests) would bring most of the unreadable entries into the census. (2) The dynamic report's missing site is stated in dispatch-matrix.md and SURFACE_MEMBERSHIP_CENSUS's doc: the static census names ten escaping wrappers on 00277 (w10, w11, w20 with four members; w13-w19 with eleven) and the twelve dynamic escapes cannot be attributed among them until observe prints its PlanSite.

title: The dynamic tripwire prints no plan site and the static census silently skips 82.5% of entry plans: name the wrapper/callsite in the escape report and read Region::List questions
